labelOrder.description: Labels in rank order, first ranks highest (for example p0, p1, p2). issue.ready sorts an item by the first of these labels it carries; items with none come last, and ties keep their stored order. Left empty, issue.ready does not reorder.

idPrefix.description: The prefix new issue ids carry, as in <idPrefix>-<n>. Derived from the project: the origin remote's repository name, else the main checkout's folder name, normalised to lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Every item is shown with the current prefix; an id with any earlier prefix (work-12 after a change to acme) still names the same item.
